duration: Separate optional operation; independent approval waits unknown
cost: Existing resources plus image builds/storage/runners/network may bill
summary: Phase 7: application-only preparation for existing AKS/ACR. Required real inputs, current trusted main, same-run immutable digests and independent live-verifiable approval are non-negotiable.

purpose.p: Explain a protected existing-infrastructure delivery path without silently provisioning or authenticating to finish a preparation exercise.
Agents may prepare/review files only. No cluster/registry/namespace/RBAC/ingress creation, Azure sign-in, image build/push, kubeconfig retrieval, dispatch or deployment by an agent.

starting_state.p: IT owns existing AKS/ACR, a precreated restricted namespace, approved build/deploy identities, kubelet pull permissions, runner network/tool readiness and supported GitHub environment protections.

steps.title: Require real existing-resource and image inputs
steps.where: Repository Settings › Secrets and variables › Actions › Variables

head: Required variables
Meaning; no example values
rows: Approved existing target; identifiers are not passwords
Approved connected equipped Linux deployment runner labels
Approved equipped Linux image-build runner for restricted ACR when needed

body.p: Application namespace/images remain required inputs with no placeholder/default demo images or latest tags. Deployment consumes immutable digests produced by its own run, not a hand-entered mutable tag. Do not collect these values or secrets in this HTML.

No client secrets, AZURE_CREDENTIALS, registry passwords, access tokens or admin kubeconfig. Reverify actual immutable OIDC subject format/ref/environment with IT; old/widened/wildcard trust is not recovery.

steps.expect: Real approved prerequisites or explicit unset inputs; no provisioning to make the plan look complete.

steps.title: Prepare/review application objects and static gates only

body.p: Review required namespace/digest inputs, non-root Deployments, health probes, requests/limits and ClusterIP Services. Existing templates also restrict capabilities, root filesystem, seccomp and service-account token use. Static checks do not fill missing inputs or prove a live cluster.
Use existing dependencies only. No authentication, tool acquisition, image build/publish, namespace creation, public ingress, firewall change or cloud dispatch.

steps.expect: Static file evidence, real missing inputs and unobserved live checks explicitly separated.

steps.title: Verify actual independent environment protections

ul: Prevent self-review enabled; administrators cannot bypass protection.
Selected branches/tags: exactly one Branch rule for main; no tag/wildcard/PR rule.
Protect trusted main and workflow/checker/manifests through governance; editable YAML alone is not an independent boundary.

callout.text: Private environment creation is not proof of reviewer support. Use a compatible GitHub plan and verify actual live REST protections/readability. If controls are unavailable, absent or unverifiable, fail closed: no bare-dispatch downgrade, extra long-lived token workaround or visibility change.

steps.expect: Verified live protection and independent reviewer evidence, not a claim based only on a named environment.

steps.title: Trust current main, exact source SHA and modern CI

body.p: Manual workflow_dispatch only on trusted main. Required source_sha must equal the dispatch revision and current remote main. If main moves, stop and start a new reviewed run; this guide's dated pin and demo-complete are not dispatch inputs.

Modern Python/current Java/Go and repository checks precede separate OIDC registry build/push. Same-run immutable digests pass through job outputs; distinct deploy identity cannot use a mutable tag or unrelated digest.

IT verifies ACR mode: non-ABAC AcrPush/AcrPull vs ABAC repository-scoped Writer/Reader, conditional permissions and separately justified catalog/read scope. Kubelet pulls images; no attach-acr/role grant or broad Contributor/Owner workaround.

steps.expect: Exact current-main test/digest/governance evidence or a fail-closed stop.

steps.title: Only an authorized human requests and monitors deployment
steps.where: Terminal › Run Task › Deploy AKS (manual main only)

body.p: Only after prerequisites and live protections are verified, the human supplies the reviewed current full main SHA to the actual named task and explicitly confirms. The optional code below remains visibly unresolved until a valid SHA is entered; copy never dispatches.

Dispatch is a request, not environment approval. A different approved reviewer uses Review deployments: aks-demo. Protections/source are rechecked before Azure OIDC; the deploy identity uses user, never admin, kubeconfig and Entra kubelogin in the existing namespace.

Already equipped connected Linux runners are required; labels alone do not prove API/DNS/TLS/ACR/identity reachability. Never make a private API public, disable validation, install runner tools or grant admin credentials to fix a run.

steps.expect: An actual independent approval and rollout/health result, or a truthful wait/failure. No live action is performed by HTML/agent.

steps.title: Inspect namespace-scoped status, logs and loopback access
steps.where: Terminal › Kubernetes status / Kubernetes logs / Kubernetes port-forward

body.p: Use already approved local user kubeconfig/network context, the actual existing namespace and the selected modern sample. No task should acquire admin credentials, create namespace/RBAC or expose public ingress.

Port-forward occupies its integrated terminal and uses loopback; human stops only that owned operation with Ctrl+C and uses a second terminal for health/synthetic requests. Inspect actual rollout/probe/health evidence, never assume a past deployment.

steps.expect: Observed namespace-scoped outcomes or NOT RUN. Existing Azure resources keep their normal costs; this plan never deletes them.

expected.p: Files-only preparation may be complete while cloud deployment is not authorized or available. A real accepted delivery requires current-main tests, same-run image digests, independent approval and observed rollout/health.

success.p: Observe live governance/source checks, modern CI, distinct identity scopes, same-run registry digests, independent reviewer and actual rollout/health. None is inferred from static files or a dispatched workflow.

failures.cause: Private-plan limitation, missing controls or insufficient live verification
failures.fix: Fail closed and do not deploy. Obtain independently verifiable supported protection through approved administration; no visibility/token/admin bypass.

failures.symptom: Current main moved or digests do not match this run
failures.cause: Stale source input or mutable/unrelated image identity
failures.fix: Stop and request a new separately reviewed current-main run; never deploy fallback/tag/PR/legacy code.

failures.symptom: Missing variables/namespace/tools/RBAC or private API reachability
failures.fix: Report the exact missing input/check NOT RUN; do not authenticate, provision, grant rights, fetch tools or open networks to finish prep.
Stop acceptance and inspect authorized namespace evidence; no unrelated resource deletion or unsafe baseline recovery.

recovery.p: Retain existing cloud resources and all source. Re-review a new current-main run only after the real blocker is resolved through authorized human/IT processes.

limitations.p: No Azure authentication, live cluster inspection, image publication, dispatch, reviewer approval or deployment was observed/performed by this companion.

say: We prepare application files for existing AKS and ACR, not new infrastructure.
Dispatch, immutable digests and independent approval are separate gates.
Unverifiable protections fail closed; a PR never deploys.
evidence_gaps: Static documentation and underlying CI do not prove current GitHub protection availability, existing Azure inputs/network/RBAC, independent review, immutable image delivery or live rollout.
